findings: Non-blocking (cosmetic): the bottom fade (h-16) and the bottom-2 pill overlay the lower ~64px of the scrollable content. The fade is pointer-events-none so it does not block interaction and the pill disappears at the bottom; optionally add bottom padding to the content wrapper so the final field clears the pill.

Non-blocking (types): ScrollOverflowState declares scrollRef/contentRef as RefObject<HTMLDivElement> while useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null) yields the nullable form under current React types. tsc is reported clean so it compiles today; consider tightening to RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null> to stay robust against a React types bump.
